About the Fellowship

Harvard's Ethics and Civics Fellowship supports postdoctoral research connecting ethical scholarship with education and public life. The appointment is based in the Research and Design Studio, with particular attention to disagreement, civic discourse and practical research contributions.

Research Areas

  • Ethics
  • Civics
  • Research and pedagogy

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPostdoctoral fellowship
Stipend / salaryUSD 7,000/month, September–June; up to USD 3,000 research allowance
DurationSeptember 2027 to June 2028

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityWorldwide, subject to programme rules
Academic preparationDoctorate completed no more than three years before the fellowship begins.
Further conditionsPhD completed no more than three years before fellowship start; all citizenships.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round15 November 2026
LocationUnited States

About Harvard University

Harvard hosts research fellowships through its academic schools, institutes and centres. Each fellowship has its own research focus, eligibility rules and application process, separate from doctoral admission.
